findings.title: UTM-V3 semantic-verifier fixture and receipt discipline can reuse the existing isolated judge harness pattern
findings.original_premise: Keep deterministic structural checks separate from a versioned semantic judge; build human-labeled adversarial cases and report false-pass/false-fail by class. Do not inherit the external VerMem paper result.
findings.revised_deliverable: Before any live semantic judging, prepare the human-labeled case manifest and deterministic mock-primitive/parser fixtures using the existing judge_redundancy receipt pattern: frozen case/rubric hashes, explicit per-criterion outputs, parse/transport failure as unresolved, and separate agreement from accuracy against human gold. Reuse existing Question/DecisionResult where an output is truly a closed choice; preserve arbitrary memory-operation explanation/payload as source data. No new grading ladder, no import of CJ-13 synthetic ground truth, no semantic-validity claim from reader agreement, and no live judge call required for this preparation.

toolkit_reuse.what: Demonstrates frozen hashed evaluator cases, strict output parsing, unresolved failures, and a structural distinction between accuracy against known ground truth and reader-reader agreement. Reuse fixture/receipt mechanics only; UTM’s human-labeled cases remain its own ground truth.

Typed choices can capture a genuinely closed decision; parse/schema failure is carried explicitly rather than defaulted. Not suitable as a substitute for arbitrary semantic rationale or host-side structural validation.

source_evidence.observation: UTM-V3 explicitly separates deterministic structural verification from a semantic judge and requires human labels/adversarial classes.
Existing isolated grader scaffold hashes frozen cases and distinguishes accuracy from agreement; malformed or unresolved emissions do not become verdicts.
Typed runner returns per-question ParseFailure and does not silently default missing decisions.

findings.non_inference_scope: Own human-gold manifest/rubric design plus mocked output/failure/receipt fixtures. No model call or memory mutation.
findings.inference_acceptance: UTM own versioned semantic judge, human gold and per-class false-pass/false-fail calibration; do not transfer CJ synthetic gold.
findings.gate: Host structural checks and UTM-M9 human amendment remain separate; no live activation or new belief ladder.
